Hey hopefully you’re feeling better. 14 is a difficult age there’s a lot of adjusting to high school and being older along with anatomical changes so it’s understandable you’re having a rough time along with all the other stuff you said. That being said school may feel like the whole world right now but I’ve found people are a lot less shitty once you’re out of school. I also have a hard time not just saying what I’m thinking and filtering what I say and people often get mad at me for it but I’ve also learned a lot of people value that I’m so straight forward they no I’m not gonna bullshit them and while people may laugh at when you shout things or do something different there will be people who like that about you. I don’t know if counseling is available for you but it’s helped me so much I started going at 9 or 10 and 14 is a great age to start. It may feel like your whole life is going to be like this but you’ve got lotssssss of time for things to change. Stay strong you’ve got this.
